name: kk-cursor-agent
description: External subagent type backed by the Cursor CLI over ACP (`agent acp`).
systemPrompt: The kk-cursor-agent plugin contributes the `kk-cursor-agent.cursor` subagent profile for the Agent tool. Use it when the user explicitly asks to delegate work to Cursor, or when a task benefits from Cursor's codebase-indexed retrieval. External subagents run with auto-approved tool permissions in the current workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Cursor CLI as an external subagent (ACP)

subagents.name: cursor
subagents.description: Cursor CLI agent driven over ACP (agent acp); good for codebase-indexed search and edits
subagents.promptPrefix: You are running as a delegated subagent inside kkagent. Work only inside the provided working directory and return a concise final summary.
